tagline: Spec-driven agentic delivery for shippable software.

features.title: Harness bootstrap
features.summary: Create the initial reusable harness structure, instructions, docs, templates, command contracts, and verification script.

features.title: Command contracts
features.summary: Harden operational command prompts with consistent headings, file boundaries, and lifecycle transitions.

features.title: MVP and SHIP mode system
features.summary: Define mode selection, mode-specific criteria, and feature closure behavior.

features.title: Production-readiness gates
features.summary: Formalize SHIP mode criteria for security, data correctness, performance, failure modes, observability, tests, UX, and operations.

features.title: Context7 MCP policy
features.summary: Document when agents must use current external documentation checkpoints and when local bookkeeping is enough.

features.title: Review artifacts
features.summary: Standardize reviewer outputs, evidence capture, rejection reasons, and closure records.

features.title: Template packaging
features.summary: Package the harness so it can be reused as a clean starter for future application repos.

features.title: Executable graph runtime
features.summary: Provide typed graph execution, append-only evidence, gate enforcement, dependency scheduling, and localized repair for consuming application repositories.
